spec.title: Digital Clock with 12/24-Hour Toggle
spec.summary: The clock app displays the current local time in both 12‑hour and 24‑hour formats, updating every second. It features a toggle button to switch formats, uses responsive CSS for mobile friendliness, and is built entirely with client‑side technologies.

files.name: index.html
files.purpose: Main HTML page establishing the page structure for a dynamic digital clock application, including a container for the time display and a toggle button to switch between 12-hour and 24-hour formats, with semantic markup and responsive layout hooks.

files.name: style.css
files.purpose: CSS stylesheet applying visual design to the clock interface, setting font styles, layout flexbox, color scheme, responsive media queries, and smooth transitions for the toggle interaction.

files.name: app.js
files.purpose: Pure JavaScript module that initializes current time, updates the displayed time every second, handles toggle button clicks to switch between 12-hour and 24-hour formats, formats time string with leading zeros, updates DOM elements, and ensures minimal re‑rendering for performance.

acceptance_criteria: The clock displays the correct current local time immediately after the page loads.
The displayed time updates precisely every second without drift or delay.
Clicking the toggle button switches the displayed time format between 12‑hour AM/PM and 24‑hour notation correctly.
The clock layout remains readable and centered on viewports ranging from 320px to 1920px wide.
The time string shows leading zeros for hours, minutes, and seconds for consistency across all formats.
